description:
Nokia is searching for a qualified candidate to work as a Product Engineer focused on the introduction of next-generation coherent optical transceivers.  Working in a vertically integrated organization, there will be opportunity to help products achieve industry leading performance through engineering optimization end-to-end.  The candidate hired to this position will support new product introduction such as the 1.6T optical transceiver, and the subsequent yield stabilization that will follow.  The position provides a rich learning environment that is highly cross-functional with hardware design, test, firmware, reliability, and manufacturing teams.  The ideal candidate has a background in optical engineering and/or coherent communications systems, enjoys data analysis and developing automation solutions, and can ramp up quickly in a multi-disciplinary environment.  The position is based in Allentown, Pennsylvania.    

 Review customer-facing spec proposals for Nokia’s coherent optical modules, identifying yield concerns and proposing resolutions.  Understand how these requirements filter back to specs on the key components including the photonic integrated circuit (PIC) and high-speed driver/TIA.   

 
 Perform statistical data analysis on large data sets to characterize and improve product capability   

 
 Identify opportunities for automation of analyses and general work-flow tasks   

 
 Maintain product engineering infrastructure and ensure spec traceability to the manufacturing line.   

 
 Drive improvements in product performance during prototype phase and identify opportunities to increase product volumes and/or reduce cost in the volume phase.   

 

 M.S or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or Physics with focus in electronics, optics, communications, or semiconductors    

 
 Experimental background in photonics – such as laser, modulator, photodetector or optical system characterization   

 
 Experience with coherent optical system concepts and measurement methods is desirable   

 
 Strong data skills including writing data-manipulation scripts, performing statistical analysis, finding underlying issues in the data, and validating hypotheses using data analytics   

 
 Comfortable presenting data and making proposals to technical audiences   

 
 Team oriented with ability to work cross-functionally with excellent communication skills  

 

 
 Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 


 
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.  



 
 Learn more about life at Nokia .


 
 



 
 



 
 Our recruitment process 

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.  Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
